        <div id="cc-matrix-2543362084"><div id="cc-m-9918370684" class="j-module n j-header "><h3 class="" id="cc-m-header-9918370684">Rügen Piraten</h3></div><div id="cc-m-9918411384" class="j-module n j-spacing ">
    <div class="cc-m-spacer" style="height: 5px;">
    
</div>

</div><div id="cc-m-9918370784" class="j-module n j-text "><p style="text-align: justify;">
    The dream of water sports - windsurfing, kiting, sailing, SUP, canoeing ... our friends the Rügen Pirates offer you pure surfing paradise! Learn your dream sport in a few days, rent surfing and
    kite equipment, enjoy a canoe trip over the Bodden ... EXPERIENCE THE MOST BEAUTIFUL SURF AND KITESPOT ON RÜGEN!
</p></div></div>    </div>

        <div id="cc-matrix-2542419984"><div id="cc-m-9914318084" class="j-module n j-text "><p style="text-align: left;">
    NOHOTEL - LAMPES PIRATEN KOJE
</p>
